annotations.title: Extract frames from a Playground clip

description: Take the first and/or last frame of a finished clip and place each on the canvas as a Frame Grab node wired from the clip, holding a real stored image. A frame node can then feed an image → video node as first_frame or last_frame (playground_canvas_apply_operations connect with role). Only "first" and "last" are supported; a timestamp in seconds is refused. Free: no credits are spent. Revision checked and idempotent; it can take up to two minutes. Returns created frame node IDs, image URLs, revision and Playground URL.

expectedRevision.description: Current canvas revision from canvas_read; on revision_conflict, read again and rebuild the change.

idempotencyKey.description: Unique key for this request; reuse only when retrying the identical request after a lost response. Use a new key after quoting or changing inputs.

positions.description: Frame positions to extract: first, last, or timestamps in seconds from the video start.

projectId.description: ID of the Playground project chosen for this task; obtain it from project creation, an explicit project link or current context.

videoNodeId.description: Existing canvas video node ID containing the source video.

name: playground_video_extract_frames

next.description: Suggested next action; it does not authorize spending.
